_comment: Single source of truth for FinSight build/release dependency governance. Values verified against PyPI/python.org/sqlite.org on the 'as_of' date. Product code (src/finsight) contains NO version-management or self-update logic; this file is consumed only by build/validate_deps.py and CI.

python.note: 3.9 is end-of-life (security support ended 2025-10) and is below the floor required by the pinned pytest 9.x / coverage 7.15.x. Recommended build interpreter is 3.12 (supported to 2028-10). CI matrix should test 3.11/3.12/3.13 on Windows + macOS (NFR-029).

sqlite.source: stdlib-bundled (not pip-managed; travels with the Python build)
sqlite.note: 3.35 floor covers ON CONFLICT upsert (3.24) and WAL used by the DAL, with margin. Report only; never fail the product on the bundled patch level.
